resources.string: Add a separate Hail shortcut for every launchable app in this Android profile, including disabled apps. Each icon keeps Hail’s unfreeze-and-open action.

For automatic adding, enable Hail’s shortcut assistant in Android Accessibility settings once. During a batch you start, it confirms only Hail’s Add shortcut prompts in your selected launcher and keeps the screen on while adding them. It stops when the batch ends, is paused or cancelled, or you lock the screen. You can disable the assistant again at any time.
Waiting for the shortcut assistant to connect…
Manual mode asks you to approve each shortcut in your launcher.
No launchable apps were found in this Android profile.
The previous batch was interrupted. Resume to check existing shortcuts and continue.
The batch paused because the device locked or this Android profile became inactive. Unlock the device and resume.
Your default launcher changed. Switch back to the original launcher to resume, or cancel and start a new batch.
Your current launcher does not support adding individual shortcuts. Choose a compatible default launcher and try again.
Verified batch adding requires Android 8 or later. You can still add individual shortcuts from each app’s menu.
The current shortcut could not be added. Check your launcher, then retry or skip this app.
The batch could not start in the background. Return to this screen and try again.
Hail could not save batch progress. The batch has stopped. Free some storage and try again.
The current launcher confirmation did not finish. Shortcuts already added are preserved. Resume checks them before continuing; retry or skip this app if needed.
Batch cancelled. Shortcuts already added stay on your Home screen. A launcher prompt already on screen may still need to be dismissed.
The shortcut assistant is unavailable. Enable it again, then resume the batch.
Approve this shortcut in your launcher. If you dismiss it, return here to retry or skip it.
